reviews.text:
They ask about any areas of concern beforehand and then trim or tidy up accordingly. The shop is very clean, and I always feel at ease leaving my cat there.

The number of staff members has increased, and my cat is now often with other people's cats. I'm impressed by how they manage even grumpy cats, timing things carefully to avoid overworking them. My cat is gradually getting used to them, and I feel a little guilty when she gets angry and asserts herself, but I still use their services.
I was very satisfied with the incredibly smooth finish they gave me!

This was my first time booking a shampoo and haircut. My cat, a long-haired British Shorthair, hates brushing and is very restless, so I'd been wanting to get her groomed for a long time, but I couldn't find a good salon.

That's when I found "Catsalon Mewty."

The staff were incredibly kind from the moment we arrived, making me feel at ease and confident that I could leave my cat there for two hours.

I was so excited to see the finished result, but she looked just as adorable as a baby! I was extremely happy!

It's a truly wonderful salon. I will definitely use their services again! 100% recommended! ✨

📸 Before and after photos are also included!

I visited for my kitten's first shampoo.

I was worried that my mischievous kitten might cause trouble, but you kindly taught me about cat care and training, which was very helpful.

The shampoo and cut I requested resulted in a look so adorable, like a stuffed animal! I was so impressed. Thank you so much.

I was feeling a bit down because I was worried about how to raise my kitten, but you listened to me so attentively, and it really lifted my spirits. I'm so grateful that you took the time to talk to me despite your busy schedule.

I would definitely like to use your services again.

I took my long-haired cat for grooming. They took pictures, complimented my cat, brushed her teeth, and advised me that she had tartar buildup and that I should take her to the clinic. I was very grateful for the health advice they gave me. It's a bit further away since they moved, so I haven't been able to go yet, but I would like to go again.

This was my first time using their service, and it was the best I've ever used!
My cat hates brushing and teething at home, so I was worried he might get violent, but I was relieved when they said he's a well-behaved cat with a good personality.
I asked for a little something extra, but they did their best to accommodate, and I'm very happy with the result! His fur is so fluffy and smells so good, I just want to hold him forever, lol.
The staff were also very kind, and they were very helpful in teaching me how to care for him at home.
It was a wonderful environment that not only made my cat feel safe, but also made me feel at ease as I left him there. ✨I'll definitely use their services again!
Thank you so much for the adorable result. The staff were also very kind, and I felt completely at ease leaving everything to them.

I own a Ragdoll cat, and I was struggling to properly care for the long fur around her neck and hindquarters, so I was looking for a grooming salon. While there are many grooming salons for dogs, there are very few that accept cats, which was frustrating until I found Mewty.

The owner and staff's treatment of cats was truly wonderful, and I felt completely at ease leaving my cat in their care. They kept me updated on her progress throughout the grooming process and took many photos and videos, which was incredibly helpful in understanding how she was doing.

The finished result was absolutely adorable—so cute I can't help but show her off! Their consideration for the cat, as well as their courteous service to the owner, was outstanding, and I'm truly satisfied.

I definitely want to have my other cats groomed there as well. The peace of mind, reliable skills, and heartwarming service that only a cat-only salon can offer makes me want to return again and again. If you're having trouble with your cat's fur, I highly recommend visiting Mewty.

I had my cat groomed for the first time.
At home, she runs away and won't let me bathe her, trim her nails, brush her, or cut her hair... and her matted fur was unbelievable... Even though it was a cat-specialized grooming salon, I was prepared for them to refuse because she's so unruly, but...
When I saw the photos and videos of the grooming process and the finished photos, I couldn't believe it was my cat!?!?! She was so well-behaved.
What kind of magic did they use?
The finished result is adorable... 5 stars isn't enough!!
I definitely want to bring her back regularly from now on! I'm extremely satisfied!
